name: Castrillo de Villavega (Spain)
description: Three horizontal stripes of red, white and blue in the proportions 2:1:1, charged at the upper hoist with a white Maltese cross.
history: Municipal flag of Castrillo de Villavega; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Maltese cross at the upper hoist
